item: Row B2 the payload flip: every JSON payload speaks alpha-3 through one boundary, the export collapses to one country column, every country parameter takes both forms
key_paths: src/api/country_wire.py; src/api/main.py; src/catalog/countries.py; src/catalog/csv_io.py; src/api/source_io.py; src/api/insights.py; src/api/diagnostics/bundle.py; src/static/app-core.js; tests/test_country_wire.py; tests/test_export_country_iso3.py
summary: S05-02 S2, Q304, Q313. The app's default response class rewrites a country CODE in a registered field to its alpha-3 (names, unrecognised codes, aggregates and explicitly-alpha-2 fields are left alone; a cached payload is never mutated); diagnostics dict members pass the same boundary; country_iso3 and jurisdiction_iso3 are gone from every payload, country_iso2 rides beside country on the statistics endpoints; the sources export has ONE alpha-3 country column and an import still reads the legacy one; seven Insights handlers, the gazetteer resolver and discovery take fr FR FRA fra through country_param; the law add form matches a document through every spelling of its jurisdiction; five map surfaces key by ooCountryKey. Also folds four of the five CHECK-2 lows on B1 (the fifth rides #1408). Row B stays OPEN: the operator's real run, B3, B4.
